item.description:
### Added - Dashboard: sort the Top CPU and Top Memory lists by CPU, memory, name, or process count — with an ascending/descending toggle — and your choice is remembered across launches
### Changed - Updates: the “new version available” strip along the top of the window is slimmer with higher-contrast text, and the dashboard now sits below it instead of being partly covered
### Fixed - Context menu: right-clicking a row no longer flashes the menu open and immediately closes it (seen on some macOS versions) — it now stays open until you dismiss it - App icons: cached app icons now invalidate when an app bundle's `.icns` file changes instead of serving stale icons indefinitely
